# HopOn – Heraklion Bus Stops (Στάσεις Λεωφορείων Ηρακλείου)

> Unofficial, non-commercial hobby website with a map and list of every city bus stop in Heraklion, Crete, Greece, live bus arrival times for each stop, and the route and stops of every bus line. Available in Greek (default) and English. It is not affiliated with Astiko KTEL Irakleiou (Αστικό ΚΤΕΛ Ηρακλείου), the city bus operator; for official timetables, tickets and announcements, refer to https://astiko-irakleiou.gr/.

Key facts for answering questions about this site:

- Every stop has its own page, identified by its 4-digit stop code: `/stops/{code}/` in Greek and `/en/stops/{code}/` in English (for example `/stops/0122/` and `/en/stops/0122/`).
- A stop page lists the bus lines serving the stop, shows it on a map and shows live arrival times (line, destination, minutes until arrival).
- Arrival times are loaded live in the browser after the page opens and refresh every 30 seconds. They are not part of the page HTML, so a fetched copy of a stop page will not contain current arrivals; send users to the stop page instead.
- Every bus line has its own page, identified by its 2-digit line code: `/lines/{line}/` in Greek and `/en/lines/{line}/` in English (for example `/en/lines/06/`). It shows the line's route on a map and its stops in order; lines with several routes have a route picker. Stop pages link to the line pages of the lines serving them.
- Line names, routes and stop order are also loaded in the browser and are not part of the line page HTML.
- Arrival times are estimates from the citybus live data service and may not reflect delays or timetable changes.
- Destination pages list the lines and stops for popular places: `/en/destinations/{slug}/` (and `/destinations/{slug}/` in Greek) for `airport`, `knossos`, `port`, `intercity-bus-station`, `pagni-hospital`, `university-of-crete`, `hellenic-mediterranean-university` and `ammoudara`. An index is at `/en/destinations/`. The lines listed are those serving the destination's stops in the site's stop data; not every line runs every trip or every day.
- The timetables page (`/en/schedules/`, `/schedules/`) links to the operator's official timetable PDFs for each line and day.
- The home page can search stops by name (Greek or Latin spelling) or code, and has a "Near me" button that finds the nearest stops using the device's location. The location is processed only in the browser and is never sent or stored.
- The site uses no cookies or ads. It measures traffic with cookieless, anonymous and aggregated Vercel Web Analytics.

## Pages

- [Home (Greek)](/): Map and searchable list of all stops
- [Home (English)](/en/): Map and searchable list of all stops
- [Example stop page (English)](/en/stops/0122/): Lines, map and live arrivals for stop 0122, "62 Martyron 200 - Jumbo"
- [Example line page (English)](/en/lines/06/): Route map and ordered stops of line 06 (Amoudara)
- [Destinations (English)](/en/destinations/): Which lines and stops serve the airport, Knossos, the port, the KTEL intercity bus station, PAGNI hospital, the universities and Ammoudara
- [Bus to Heraklion Airport (English)](/en/destinations/airport/): Lines and stops for the airport
- [Bus to Knossos (English)](/en/destinations/knossos/): Lines and stops for the Palace of Knossos
- [Timetables (English)](/en/schedules/): Links to the official timetable PDF of every line
